raw_text: China's latest information campaign over Arunachal Pradesh represents a textbook case of cognitive warfare — the deliberate use of information to alter adversary decision-making. The coordinated timing with PLA exercises suggests an integrated civil-military approach to narrative operations. India should invest in counter-narrative capabilities and strengthen its strategic communications.
